involved_tools.name: convert_time
involved_tools.description:
Convert a time from a source timezone to a target timezone.

Usage rules:
- Provide the required `time` in 24-hour `HH:MM` format and both `source_timezone` and `target_timezone` as IANA timezone names.
- If the user omits either timezone, use `America/New_York` for that timezone.
- Use valid IANA names, such as `Asia/Tokyo` or `America/Los_Angeles`.

source_timezone.description: Source IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Use 'America/New_York' as local timezone if no source timezone provided by the user.
source_timezone.title: Source Timezone

target_timezone.description: Target IANA timezone name (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'America/San_Francisco'). Use 'America/New_York' as local timezone if no target timezone provided by the user.
target_timezone.title: Target Timezone
